item.description: Europe #5236 the Twice-Born was broken in the archipelago (the stone in their midst (House of Udaeus)). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown. Europe has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.
